variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.body: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.body: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.body: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
